## ANAPLASMA PHAGOCYTOPHILUM (HUMAN GRANULOCYTOTROPIC ANAPLASMOSIS)
## Treatment
Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h for 10 days ($) [DI]
< OR >
Doxycycline 100 mg IV q12h for 10 days ($$) [DI]
References:
Mandell chapter: Rickettsioses, Ehrlichioses, and Anaplasmosis
MMWR RR. 2016, 65 (2) 1-44
Sanford keyword: Ehrlichia sp., Anaplasma sp.
Up-to-Date article: Human ehrlichiosis and anaplasmosis
